brief.zh: 23 回合内和四台对手抢电。它们会随比分和路线改变目标。第 6、12、17 回合结束后，各有一批未收走的电池改仓，门也会切换。有机器人或电池占住的门当次保持开启。电池抢完或回合用尽时，必须独占第一。多人同回合拾取同一块电池时，优先权按记分板顺序轮换，第 1 回合从芽芽开始。从容模式下，同一份程序须通过 2 张地图。
brief.en: Race four rivals for batteries over 23 turns. They change targets based on scores and routes. Some unclaimed batteries transfer to another depot after turns 6, 12, and 17 as the gates change. A gate stays open for that shift if occupied by a robot or battery. Finish first outright when the batteries run out or the turn limit is reached. For simultaneous pickups of the same battery, priority rotates in scoreboard order starting with Sprout on turn 1. In Relaxed mode, one program must win on all 2 maps.
